## Featured projects

- [LinkLens — Enterprise Link Intelligence Platform](https://mahbub.dev/projects/linklens/): LinkLens is a self-hosted link management and redirect platform built with NestJS, Redis, ClickHouse and Next.js, separating a fast redirect path from asynchronous analytics. _(NestJS, Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, ClickHouse, Prisma, Docker)_
- [Bangla & English ASR Studio](https://mahbub.dev/projects/bangla-and-english-asr-studio/): A local-first speech-to-text studio and Whisper fine-tuning pipeline for Bangla and English: transcription UI, batch jobs, WER/CER benchmarking and guarded LoRA training. _(Python, Whisper, faster-whisper, Gradio, Transformers, LoRA, Audio Processing, ML Evaluation)_
- [Local Vocal Agent](https://mahbub.dev/projects/local-vocal-agent/): A full-stack voice assistant that runs locally: FastAPI and React, an Ollama-hosted LLM, speech-to-text and text-to-speech, and SQLite plus Chroma memory. _(FastAPI, React, Ollama, SQLite, ChromaDB, Whisper, TTS, RAG)_
- [Advanced Finance Tracker](https://mahbub.dev/projects/advanced-finance-tracker/): An offline-first personal finance app built with Expo React Native and SQLite on the device, plus a NestJS and PostgreSQL API for multi-device sync. _(React Native, Expo, TypeScript, SQLite, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Jest)_

## Other projects

- Healthcare & Medical Applications: Production-focused healthcare and medical application modules including multi-role workflows, dashboards, secure access, reporting, and payment-related integrations. _(React.js, Node.js, Laravel, MySQL, MongoDB)_

- [React Portfolio](https://github.com/Mahbub96/react_portfolio): Personal portfolio built with React/Next.js, responsive UI, SEO metadata, server-rendered sections, and admin-managed content. _(Next.js, React.js, CSS, MongoDB)_
- [Test-Buddy](https://github.com/Mahbub96/Test-Buddy): React-based test and exam management demo application built for a university software engineering course. _(React.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript)_
- [Blood Donation Management System](https://github.com/Mahbub96/BloodDonationManagementSystem): Java desktop application for managing blood donor records, blood bank information, and request tracking with SQLite storage. _(Java, SQLite, Java Swing)_
